description: Use ABS (AI Business System) to answer and act on lean / operational-excellence work with a curated knowledge base built on in-depth study of DBS (the Danaher Business System). Trigger when the user asks about DBS or how to apply methods or tools such as 5S, standard work, takt and staffing, SMED / changeover, kaizen events, problem solving (PSP, 5 Why, root cause), daily management (SQDIP boards, andon, tiered meetings), policy deployment (hoshin, X-matrix, bowler), value stream mapping, TPM / OEE, pull / kanban, VOC, sales force, talent development or M&A integration; or wants to search ABS, get an answer with sources from ABS, study an ABS course, make an execution plan with a schedule (e.g. "plan a kaizen week", "arrange lean training for middle managers"), or diagnose operations data, a document or a shop-floor photo. 中文：问 DBS（丹纳赫业务系统）、精益与经营体系的方法和工具（5S、标准作业、快速换型、改善周、问题解决、日常管理、方针展开、价值流、TPM、拉动看板等）， 或要查 ABS、问 ABS、学 ABS 课程、做规划、做业务诊断时使用。Search works without an account; the rest needs an ABS access token.
